originalTitle: People escape historic Kyiv building hit by Russian drone
summary: The BBC's Paul Adams reports from the scene of the strike on Ukraine's National Academy of Sciences.
content:
Ukraine's National Academy of Sciences has been hit by a Russian drone strike, killing one person and leaving three injured, according to city's mayor Vitaliy Klitschko.

Footage showed people leaning out of windows as they evacuated the burning building.

Firefighters helped people evacuate through the windows as a plume a black smoke billowed out of the building.

The BBC's diplomatic correspondent Paul Adams was at the scene as emergency services attempted to stop the raging fire.
chineseTitle: 人们逃离被俄罗斯无人机击中的基辅历史建筑
chineseSummary: 英国广播公司 (BBC) 的保罗·亚当斯 (Paul Adams) 在乌克兰国家科学院袭击现场进行报道。
chineseContent:
乌克兰国家科学院市长维塔利·克里琴科表示，俄罗斯无人机袭击了乌克兰国家科学院，造成 1 人死亡、3 人受伤。

视频显示，人们在撤离着火的大楼时纷纷探出窗外。

当一股黑烟从建筑物中滚滚而出时，消防队员帮助人们通过窗户疏散。

当紧急服务人员试图阻止熊熊大火时，英国广播公司的外交记者保罗·亚当斯正在现场。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于全球新闻信号，适合用于观察外部环境、政策变化、地缘风险和市场情绪。
